common_violations.rule: Supabase SSR requires cookies setAll inside Next.js Middleware
common_violations.mitigation: Sempre utilizar o boilerplate do @supabase/ssr com tratamento de Server-Side Cookies na request e response. Nunca usar localStorage em ambientes server-only.

common_violations.rule: No console.log inside Next.js Server Components
common_violations.mitigation: Componentes de servidor poluem stdout. Auditor reprovou o AuthBadge.tsx.
